integrity: Analytic proof plus an executable high-precision finite checker; finite tests support but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the first-order last-indefiniteness asymptotic for uniform finite cycles is proved; finite-order crossing uniqueness, correction terms, nonequispaced samples, and powered distances other than two are not resolved. Literature comparisons were bounded, and independent validation has not been performed.
title: A sharp \(\pi/n\) last-failure scale for geodesic Gaussian matrices on finite cycles
